[short] skip
env GO111MODULE=off
cd a

# With no per-test timeout set, 'go test' injects the default 1m per-test timeout.
go test -v
stdout '^1m0s$'

# An explicit -testtimeout is propagated to -test.testtimeout.
go test -v -testtimeout 5s
stdout '^5s$'

# If -testtimeout is not set but -timeout is set explicitly, the -timeout value
# becomes the per-test default (so one long test is not killed by the 1m default).
go test -v -timeout 30m
stdout '^30m0s$'

# -testtimeout=0 disables the per-test timeout.
go test -v -testtimeout 0
stdout '^0s$'

-- a/testtimeout_test.go --
package t
import (
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"testing"
)
func TestTestTimeout(t *testing.T) {
	fmt.Println(flag.Lookup("test.testtimeout").Value.String())
}
